# Helm

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from helm/lang.json and helm/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Helm code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//dx/launch:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Helm project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Helm package from [`helm/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/helm/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl", "helm_library")

helm_library(
    name = "helm",
    srcs = ["Chart.yaml"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Quality

`dx format` formats a chart with two pinned tools. Each file goes to exactly
one of them:

- prettier formats `Chart.yaml`, `values.yaml` and the other plain YAML and
  JSON files in the chart.
- helmfmt formats Go templates: files under `templates/` next to a
  `Chart.yaml`, and `*.tpl` files. It re-indents only the lines that start
  with a template tag and leaves every other line as written.

## Packaging

### Charts

`helm_library` owns one chart, in the Bazel package that holds `Chart.yaml`
(a package is a directory with a `BUILD.bazel` file). Every file in `srcs`
must live in that package. Put vendored subchart archives, `.tgz` files under `charts/`, in
`subcharts`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl", "helm_library")

helm_library(
    name = "chart",
    srcs = [
        "Chart.yaml",
        "templates/cm.yaml",
        "values.yaml",
    ],
    subcharts = ["charts/redis-20.1.0.tgz"],
)
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//helm:defs.bzl", "helm_library")
```

### `helm_library`

Owns one Helm chart, the package holding Chart.yaml, for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subcharts` | `label_list` | no | Vendored subchart archives under charts/; never fetched. |
| `namespace` | `string` | no | Namespace passed to helm template. |
| `release_name` | `string` | no | Release name passed to helm template; at most 53 characters. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Chart files of this package, including Chart.yaml and templates. |
| `values` | `label_list` | no | Values files in order; later files override earlier ones. |

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Helm:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `helm`, `prettier`, `trivy_config` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | `Chart.yaml` |
| Lockfiles | none |

## Platforms

Helm builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
